evidence.evidence_text: In this work, we introduce SEAHORSE, a dataset for multilingual, multifaceted summarization evaluation.
We show that metrics trained with SEAHORSE achieve strong performance on the out-of-domain meta-evaluation benchmarks TRUE (Honovich et al., 2022) and mFACE (Aharoni et al., 2022).
